description: This file is a shell script named 'wait-for-it.sh' designed to check for TCP host/port availability. It provides command-line options to test connectivity, with functions to wait for a service to become available, handle timeouts, and execute subsequent commands based on the test result.

methods.name: echoerr
methods.description: Outputs error messages to stderr if not in quiet mode.

methods.name: wait_for
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a specified host and port until it succeeds or times out.

methods.name: wait_for_wrapper
methods.description: Wraps wait_for with timeout handling and supports SIGINT during waiting.
